descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92594 AC 2; UAT 3.6 · “Nursing Home shows the last two visits (UAT 3.6)”.

Bug B35 · S2 · known

Nursing Home keeps the last three visits' transcripts instead of two (TFA-92594 AC 2, UAT 3.6)

Tickets: TFA-92594 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Re-filed from D6 on 2026-10-14 (Quinn). One constant: SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3 in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-16/S14

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S11 Nursing Home keeps the last two visits, seeded: three archived visits plus one that rotates when the list opens

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Nursing Home: transcripts are kept for the last two visits. (UAT 3.6; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given {snfResident} with three archived '· Visit notes' rows (archivedAt 21, 14 and 7 days ago: 'QA16-N-R1', 'QA16-N-R2', 'QA16-N-R3') and encounterNotes 'QA16-N-R4' with encounterEditedAt = now−13 h (past the 12 h Nursing Home window)

When Switch to Nursing Home (snf:applyLifecycle runs with the server's Date.now()), open the resident's Encounter tab, look without opening anything, then open the newest row

Then R4 is listed as '<13 h ago> · Visit notes' with no manual step and has left the working box. Only R3 and R4 are listed; R1 and R2 are gone

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 Nursing Home 'last two visits' and TFA-92594 AC 2. Under either reading of Q3 (two archived visits, or the current visit plus the one before) only R3 + R4 remain: R4 is the latest visit and there is none newer. cp1 (collapsed): mustContain '{Mon D, 7 days ago} · Visit notes', '{Mon D, 13 h ago} · Visit notes'; …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment dev · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

A Nursing Home resident's Prior Encounter Transcripts list three past visits instead of the last two.

Evidence: Allure ea82a7c8. Ledger #26 U26: SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3 in lifecycle.ts. Dev report §3 row 1: Daniela decides whether the code or the UAT changes. TC-16 Q3/Q12 are open. TFA-94699 (in progress) says 'keep the last two visits'. The seed's label format mismatch is ours, not the product's.
